title: System Load
hook: Running at 100% feels productive until one surprise knocks everything over.
statement: Every system has a breaking point. Overload finds it.
explainer: Maxed out leaves no room for surprises. Buffer is what absorbs hits.
sop: List every commitment pulling on you.
Above 0.7, cut or delegate one thing.
equation_example: Demand 8 ÷ Capacity 10 = 0.8. Over 0.7, quality starts slipping. Cut something.
question: Work out your load ratio today. Over 0.7, cut one.
closing_statement: Leave room or the next surprise breaks you.
